title: Habitats
info: A habitat is the place where a living thing finds food, water, and shelter.
Deserts are dry. Oceans are salty water. Forests have many trees.

options: the place a living thing makes its home

questions.q: Which animal is built for life in the ocean?

questions.explain: Polar bears live in the Arctic, around the North Pole. Antarctica is the icy continent at the South Pole.

questions.q: Type a habitat that is covered by salty water.
